seen.body:
## Behaviour
Extend `forge.Forge` with `read_board_cards(board) -> tuple[Card]` (card id, repository, issue number, column, priority), Unsupported where the forge cannot list. Reading rules every consumer (project status, prune, the offline board's comparison) shares: (1) a card whose issue belongs to ANOTHER repository is ignored and never stands in for a missing local card, because an organization board holds several repositories whose numbers collide; (2) the same card id listed twice is a pagination overlap while cards are being added and counts once; (3) two different card ids for one issue are a real duplicate and a typed error naming both ids (exit 1); (4) a listing that exceeds the page cap raises rather than truncating (existing rule).

## Scenarios
- `foreign_repository_card_with_colliding_number_is_ignored`: board holds acme/other#5 and acme/widgets#5; only the local one counts; prevents false in-sync.
- `foreign_card_never_stands_in_for_a_missing_local_card`: only the foreign card exists: the local item is reported missing; prevents hiding a gap.
- `same_card_id_on_two_pages_is_one_card`: overlap tolerated; prevents an hour-long abort on a harmless race.
- `two_card_ids_for_one_issue_is_an_error_naming_both`: real duplicate stays loud; prevents silent double writes.

## Reference coverage
Tests (project item overlap walk, 4): card for another repository ignored, foreign card never stands in, same item id twice is overlap, two ids for one issue stays an error and is named.

## Qew today
Missing. qew never lists board cards: `place_on_board` re-adds by node id (GitHub's add is idempotent) so numbers cannot collide, but there is no way to detect or report cards. Needed by `board-status-drift-report`, `board-prune-foreign-cards` and the offline `qew board`.
seen.title: Add a read-cards operation to the Board interface with foreign-card and duplicate rules
